'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Barry Alperstein DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-40-Imperial_Occupation-remaster.webp|label=Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)}}
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
